If your Life is three or less, summon this card without paying the cost. Then, send all cores from your Trash to this Spirit.

[LV2][LV3][LV4] [True-Consecutive Blade] (When Attacks)
By sending [Soul Core] from this Spirit to your Trash, target up to two opposing Spirits/Ultimates and battle them at once. When you've done so, for each battling opposing target that is depleted/destroyed during this battle, send an opposing Life to the Reserve.

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A12227.name: The SengokuDragonGod Tenkafubu
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A12227.effect:
[Summon Condition: Your Life is at three or less]

[LV3][LV4][LV5] (Your Main Step)
The cost of every "SengokuSixGeneral"-named Ultimate card in your Hand is the same as your life.

[LV4][LV5] (When Attacks)
[Soul Drive] If you banish the [Soul Core] (Soul Core) on this Ultimate from the game, activate the [Soul Drive] of Red/Yellow/White/Green/Purple/Blue Ultimates you control, other than "SengokuDragonGod Tenkafubu," one of each color.

BS34-X06.name: The SevenSeasDaimyo Shironagasu
BS34-X06.effect:
[Burst: s] (After your Spirit is depleted/destroyed by the opponent)
Destroy all Spirits without "Lord"/"Beast Head" family. After this effect resolves, summon this card without paying the cost.

[LV2][LV3] (When Attacks)
If your Life is three or less, destroy an opposing Spirit/Ultimate with a cost equal or inferior to this Spirit's, and during this turn, for every symbol on the opposing Spirit/Ultimate destroyed by this effect, this Spirit gains an extra Blue symbol.

BS34-054.name: The SeadragonMusha Ikkaku
BS34-054.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Attacks)
Destroy an opposing Cost 4 or less Spirit.

[LV2][LV3] (When Attacks)
Look at the contents of an opposing Burst, and if it is a Spirit card/Magic card, discard that Burst.

[LV3] (When Attacks)
You can activate the Burst effect of the Burst discarded via this Spirit's effect as your own effect. However, that card can't move from the Trash.

BS34-063.name: The Single Cedar in the Shinobi's Forest
BS34-063.effect:
[LV1][LV2]
When the opponent draws, refresh a Spirit/Ultimate you control.

[LV2]
When only the opposing Spirit is destroyed by comparing BP with your "Blade Beast" family Spirit, put two cores from the Void to that Spirit you control.

BS34-028.name: The StrangeFangNinjaCommander Leo-Kamui
BS34-028.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Summoned)
Put two cores from the void to this Spirit. If [Soul Core] (Soul Core) was used to pay the summon cost, also, the opponent exhaust two Spirits they control.

[LV2][LV3] (Your Attack Step)
While there is [Soul Core] (Soul Core) on this Spirit, when the attacks of your "Vassal"/"Blade Beast" family Spirit/Ultimate reduces the opposing life, send an opposing life to their Reserve.

BS34-X03.name: The StrangeFangShinobiHead Toudou
BS34-X03.effect:
When the opposing [Soul Core] is sent to the opposing Trash, after that effect resolves, you can summon this Spirit card from the Hand, without paying the cost.

[LV2][LV3][LV4] (When Attacks/Blocks)
For each "Blade Beast" family Spirit/Ultimate you control, exhaust an opposing Spirit/Ultimate. All those Spirits/Ultimates can't be refreshed on the next (Opposing Refresh Step).

BS34-022.name: The StrangeFangShinobi Warabi
BS34-022.effect:
[Burst: s] (After your Spirit/Ultimate is destroyed by the opponent)
Exhaust an opposing Spirit. Or, refresh a "Blade Beast" family Spirit/Ultimate you control. After this effect resolves, summon this Spirit card without paying the cost.

[LV2] (When Battles)
Put a core from the Void to this Spirit.

BS34-020.name: The WindDemon Yabusame
BS34-020.effect:
Flash - [High Speed]
This Spirit card in Hand can be summoned by paying the cost with cores in the Reserve. In this case, cores to be put on this Spirit must also be from the Reserve.

[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Attacks/Blocks)
At the end of battle, by sending the [Soul Core] from this Spirit to your Trash, return this Spirit to your Hand.

BS34-071.name: The World of Owari
BS34-071.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (Your Attack Step)
All your "God-Sechs" Spirits are treated as being at their highest levels.

[LV2] (Your Attack Step)
While your "God-Sechs" Spirit is attacking, the opponent can only block with their Spirit with the highest BP.
